picks.reasoning: Lebosnoyani by decision at +320 (24% implied, 27% ours). The market makes him a 76% favourite but prices a decision at only 21%, i.e. it expects him to finish about three of every four wins. Both of his UFC wins went the full 15 minutes, and Hasanov has never been stopped: a chain wrestler who kept shooting while tired and took Eric Nolan the distance. If Lebosnoyani wins, the scorecards are the likeliest way.
